titel: Why You Should Never Give A Tired Bee Honey

beats.say: Why should you never give a tired bee... *honey?*
Rudi finds a bumblebee that can't fly. And he goes full *rescue mode.*
So he pours it a whole jar of *honey.* Now the bee is sticky... and sick.
So Rudi opens a honey *bar* for every bee in town. Now they're all getting ill.
Honey can carry *germs* that make bumblebees sick.
And most tired bees aren't dying. They're just *resting.*
So give it time. Check back in about *forty-five minutes.*
Still stuck? Move it onto a *flower.* No flowers? One drop of sugar water on a spoon.
So next time you find a tired bee... ask yourself:
